text:
jason: kicking off a regional canary for embeddings-service v3.0.1 -> 5% global, eu-west 25% per change window. keep eyes on embed-distance drift and p99 latency.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: embeddings-service v3.0.1 -> global 5% | eu-west 25%. Details: https://deploys/redwood/emb/v3.0.1 · [perf metrics] · [traces]
rita: getting early telemetry: eu-west embed-similarity drift +3.5% MSE vs baseline on a synthetic prompt set, not just latency.
henry: also seeing an uptick in tail latency in eu-west edge pods. p99 increased from 180ms -> 320ms.
qa-bot: Automated quality checks: regression flagged on embed-similarity (threshold 2.0%). Testset: nightly-eval-embeddings. See: https://e2e/reports/2958671234
jason: hmm. hold the percentage increases. henry, can you cap eu-west back to 5%? opsbot, what are regional pin options?
henry: running redwoodctl routing split --service embeddings-service --region eu-west --weights v3.0.1=5,v3.0.0=95 to reduce exposure.
deploy-bot: Routing update: eu-west weights updated by henry. eu-west traffic -> v3.0.1 at 5%. Global still 5%.
henry: reducing now. watching for drift to revert.
rita: even at 5% in eu-west, the similarity regression persists on a subset of queries with long contexts. traces show more tokenization/batching variance.
jason: do we want to completely pin back to v3.0.0 for eu-west only? we can do region-level pin: `redwoodctl routing pin --service embeddings-service --version v3.0.0 --region eu-west --reason "canary drift"`
opsbot: Note: region-level pinning supported. It will route 100% of eu-west traffic to pinned version until unpinned.
henry: I'm in favor of a partial rollback (eu-west only) so other regions can continue collecting signals. who will execute the pin?
rita: i'll run the pin, and open a ticket for RCA. also want to snapshot the batcher config and kvcache stats.
rita: `redwoodctl routing pin --service embeddings-service --version v3.0.0 --region eu-west --reason "canary similarity regression"` -> accepted.
deploy-bot: Routing update: embeddings-service pinned to v3.0.0 in eu-west by rita. eu-west traffic -> v3.0.0.
qa-bot: Verification: similarity metrics in eu-west returned to baseline within 3 minutes post-pin. Global 5% regions still reporting slight drift; continuing to monitor.
jason: good. action items: 1) keep global warm canary at 5% for 2h, 2) infra/runtime to collect batcher traces and tokenizer timings, 3) devs to run a bisect between v3.0.0 and v3.0.1 to isolate diff.
henry: scheduling a quick triage in 20m. linking ticket EMB-1189.
rita: adding a release note draft: "v3.0.1 canary partially rolled back in eu-west due to embedding similarity regression on long-context prompts; pinned to v3.0.0 in region while we investigate."
opsbot: Incident/Change ticket EMB-1189 created and linked.
jason: we will not unpin until we've validated a patch. do not proceed with any percent bumping. re-open thread for re-rollout approvals.
henry: :thumbsup: will collect logs and upload to EMB-1189.
rita: copying relevant sample traces and synthetic prompts into the ticket.
deploy-bot: Canary status: global 5% (v3.0.1), eu-west pinned -> v3.0.0.
qa-bot: scheduling a re-run of nightly-eval-embeddings on the canary build with extended long-context samples. ETA 45m.
jason: thanks everyone. closing this thread for now. escalate if any telemetry flips.
